hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/apps/*.ts|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/libs/*.ts|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/load-tests/*.ts) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --log-level warn "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
